methodology: Counts named class-like Kotlin declarations under maracuya/src/main/java/cruxui/android/maracuya, including nested declarations and wrappers: class, data class, enum class, sealed class, value class, annotation class, object and interface. Public @Composable *Mrcy functions are reported separately as API functions. A declaration only counts as template-compliant when its KDoc follows the requested fields: Descripción, Uso, @author, @since, @version, @param and @see. Any other KDoc is counted as partial debt.

A.meaning: Superficie pública o cercana al consumo del DS.

B.meaning: Tokens, modelos, resolvers o infraestructura documentable.

C.meaning: Utilidades, enums simples, previews o soporte de bajo riesgo.

weight_model.review: 25% adicional para consistencia, formato, @see, hover en IDE y revisión cruzada.
